prompts.name: energy-supply
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational / stylized-concept. Create a new wide 16:9 conceptual scientific illustration for a Delphi Bio vision film. The attached original Delphi artwork is a STYLE REFERENCE: luminous translucent blue biological structures, fine rose-coral accents, pristine pale white background, delicate detailed 3D editorial rendering. Subject: an elegant cutaway through a fish's swimming/launch muscle, showing parallel muscle fibers fed by a fine branching red-blue capillary network, with a beautifully rendered enlarged mitochondrion integrated into the foreground. Show the mitochondrion's folded inner membrane and subtle small luminous particles suggesting energy transfer. The composition should connect oxygen delivery to cellular respiration, with visual hierarchy: a few vascular branches, ordered muscle fibers, one clear mitochondrial cutaway. This is a hypothetical design illustration, not microscopy or a measured simulation. No plots, no numbers, no equations, no DNA helix, no arrows, no labels, no text, no people, no UI, no boxed panels. Large beautiful centered subject, generous white margins and clean upper-left negative space for a headline overlaid later. Match the references' scientific illustration craft and translucent materials, not a neon sci-fi look. Render as a sharp polished landscape illustration.

prompts.name: fin-material
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational / stylized-concept. Create a new wide 16:9 conceptual scientific illustration for a Delphi Bio film, matching the STYLE of the attached original Delphi deck artwork: translucent blue biological materials with delicate coral tips, pristine white background, detailed elegant 3D editorial illustration, soft shadows. Subject: an extreme close-up of one winglike pectoral fish fin, a graceful curved fan of thin fin rays under a translucent membrane. One small region of the membrane is opened into a clearly conceptual exploded material cutaway, revealing ordered collagen-like fiber bundles that bridge the rays. A few curved fibers extend into the near foreground as a magnified structural detail. The design question is how proteins and fibers might make a fin light, tough and flexible. Show one integrated elegant object, not a whole fish, not a matrix of boxes or a crowded infographic. Preserve recognizable fin-like organic structure. This is an imagined material design study, not an experimentally observed fish fin. No words, letters, numbers, equations, labels, measurement scales, plots, people, UI or DNA helix. Leave generous pale margins and clean upper-left space for a later headline. Premium scientific concept artwork matching the reference's style, natural blue silver and restrained rose coloring.

prompts.name: ecology
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / scientific-educational. Create a new wide 16:9 conceptual ecology illustration for the Delphi Bio vision film. The attached original Delphi art defines the style: precise translucent silver-blue fish, delicate rose accents, refined scientific 3D illustration, very light white-blue background. Show a graceful diagonal school of 7 small wing-finned fish moving together near the sea surface. Include a larger predatory fish below and behind, and a delicate cluster of tiny plankton/prey organisms lower in the scene, conveying an ecosystem and food web rather than isolated fish. A subtle thin blue waterline and fading underwater volume provide context; one or two fish crest the surface with fins extended, without a dramatic splash. Composition should feel like an exquisite museum scientific illustration on a white page, airy and spacious, not a realistic ocean photograph or a dark aquarium. The fish school is the focus, predator/prey secondary. This is a hypothetical ecosystem design scenario, not evidence that engineered fish exist. No text, labels, connecting arrows, equations, plots, UI, buildings, people or DNA imagery. Generous margins, clean upper-left negative space for a later headline; visual detail mainly center and lower right.
